mentions.name: Hacker Reader
mentions.description: An open source iOS client for Hacker News built with the latest iOS design language and features. It focuses on a good reading experience with no ads and no paywall, and includes extras like home screen widgets.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a simple open source iOS client for hacker news that makes use of the latest iOS design language and features.

No Ads, no paywall, just focused on a good reading experience with some extra niceties like widgets on the home screen.
